title: Inquiring About Sea Freight Container Availability
workplace_track: Export Logistics & Incoterms 2020 (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DDP)
description: Foundational sales English module covering inquiring about sea freight container availability.
learning_objectives: Master professional Polite Inquiries (Is there, Are there) in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in inquiring about sea freight container availability
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: The export consignment must clear customs _____ Friday afternoon to meet the vessel sailing date.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'by' correctly expresses the required time deadline or constraint.
explanations.wrong_C: Preposition 'on' does not fit the deadline context.
explanations.wrong_D: Preposition 'in' is ungrammatical with this time phrase.

questions.cz_learning_point: Deadline prepositions: 'by Friday' = nejpozději do pátku. Do not confuse with 'until' (až do).
